content.comment_body: To modify the speed using a FREQUENCY VARIATOR, there is an option for pulse width. A minimum pulse of 1000Hz is needed to represent a motor speed of 0Hz, and a maximum pulse of 2000Hz for 60Hz motor speed. The asynchronous pulse generator's minimum is 0.01 seconds (50 pulses per second). Is there a way with the [product_name] to generate output with frequencies in the range of 1,000 to 2,000Hz? Even a range from 1,000 to 1,200Hz would be helpful. Thanks in advance
No change, it's not feasible. The cycle time of the [product_name] is not suitable for generating such frequencies.

analysis.insight_summary: The user investigated whether the [product_name] could generate output frequencies between 1,000 and 2,000 Hz for motor control. They found that hardware limitations, specifically the internal cycle time, prevent achieving these high-frequency outputs. Another user confirmed this limitation, noting it is not possible given the slow processing speed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to be capable of generating output frequencies from 1,000 to 2,000 Hz in order to directly interface with a frequency variator for motor control.
